query: Which viability assays (in vitro germination, fluorochromatic reaction, seed set) and negative/positive controls best detect any fertility impact from fluorescent pollen staining?

response.query: Which viability assays (in vitro germination, fluorochromatic reaction, seed set) and negative/positive controls best detect any fertility impact from fluorescent pollen staining?
response.answer: In vitro germination and fluorochromatic reaction assays detect fertility impacts from fluorescent pollen staining. Positive control uses untreated pollen, while negative control uses non-viable pollen. Seed set confirms overall fertility.
